pairs.definition: A source with stronger target-free dropout response should have greater absolute canonical utility.
pairs.failure_case: Increase nuisance-source energy without changing its causal contribution.

pairs.definition: Stable source routing should predict a real family gain over static queries.
pairs.failure_case: Collapse to a deterministic but wrong source for every sample.

pairs.definition: Lower room-family CE should track higher canonical room geometry.
pairs.failure_case: Lower CE caused only by majority-class calibration.

pairs.definition: Fast final-label macro IoU should agree with the full room metric suite.
pairs.failure_case: Improve large-room masks while missing small rooms.

pairs.definition: Cheap fused-room component count should rank final canonical count error.
pairs.failure_case: Dense count matches while query budget stays systematically wrong.

pairs.definition: Lower count-gated overlap between active room queries should track higher canonical instance F1.
pairs.failure_case: Separation falls by suppressing masks without improving one-to-one room identity.

pairs.definition: Fast one-to-one type matching should agree with the full metric suite.
pairs.failure_case: Pixel accuracy improves while instance identity remains wrong.

pairs.definition: Owner-boundary agreement should predict canonical adjacency overlap.
pairs.failure_case: Smooth owner boundaries that merge two semantic rooms.

pairs.definition: Action-order violations should predict canonical validity failures.
pairs.failure_case: Correct stage order with invalid final geometry.

pairs.definition: Cheap wall raster overlap should rank vector wall F1.
pairs.failure_case: Thick raster walls inflate overlap while centerlines drift.

pairs.definition: Predicted-to-target wall-length agreement should rank vector wall F1.
pairs.failure_case: Total wall length matches while segments are disconnected or duplicated.

pairs.definition: Endpoint connectivity should rank vector wall F1.
pairs.failure_case: All endpoints connect into a wrong lattice.

pairs.definition: Wall segment cardinality error should rank vector wall F1.
pairs.failure_case: Count matches by dropping and duplicating different walls.

pairs.definition: Endpoint clustering should predict typed junction F1.
pairs.failure_case: Clustered endpoints with wrong typed degree.

pairs.definition: Correct host-wall routing should predict canonical opening F1.
pairs.failure_case: Correct host IDs with wrong intervals.

pairs.definition: Opening raster F1 should rank canonical vector opening F1.
pairs.failure_case: Raster overlap rises while interval placement or host identity drifts.

pairs.definition: Matched opening-center error should rank vector opening F1.
pairs.failure_case: Centers align after many-to-one matching.

pairs.definition: Matched opening-width error should rank vector opening F1.
pairs.failure_case: Width is accurate on the wrong host.

pairs.definition: Opening cardinality error should rank vector opening F1.
pairs.failure_case: Correct total count with wrong opening classes and hosts.

pairs.definition: Room assignment should track canonical furniture attachment.
pairs.failure_case: Correct room ID with furniture polygon outside its room.

pairs.definition: Furniture raster F1 should rank room-legal vector furniture F1.
pairs.failure_case: Diffuse masks inflate overlap without producing valid room-local polygons.

pairs.definition: Predicted furniture attachment rate should rank vector furniture F1.
pairs.failure_case: Every predicted item is assigned to a room but geometry is wrong.

pairs.definition: Valid furniture polygon rate should rank vector furniture F1.
pairs.failure_case: Valid rectangles are placed in wrong rooms.

pairs.definition: Furniture cardinality error should rank room-legal vector F1.
pairs.failure_case: Count matches through arbitrary room-local duplication.

pairs.definition: The cheap graph lower bound should rank exact fixed-evaluator GED.
pairs.failure_case: Lower node cost accompanied by higher edge cost.

pairs.definition: Matched room-type accuracy should rank semantic node F1.
pairs.failure_case: Room type accuracy is high but a semantic room type is entirely absent.

pairs.definition: Class-wise room recall should rank semantic adjacency overlap.
pairs.failure_case: Room recall rises by filling space while adjacency precision collapses.

pairs.definition: Room cardinality error should rank fixed-evaluator graph edit distance.
pairs.failure_case: Count is correct while room types and adjacency remain scrambled.

pairs.definition: Report-level room type accuracy should rank semantic node F1.
pairs.failure_case: Type accuracy is dominated by repeated common room types.

pairs.definition: Canonical room geometry should rank semantic adjacency overlap.
pairs.failure_case: Room overlap improves while boundaries introduce false adjacency.

pairs.definition: Canonical room count error should rank graph edit distance.
pairs.failure_case: Count is correct while node types and edges remain scrambled.

pairs.definition: Repair false positives should predict final legality.
pairs.failure_case: Reject-everything policy with perfect false-accept rate.

pairs.definition: Predicted edit-region overlap should rank edit-change fidelity.
pairs.failure_case: Correct region with no semantic edit.

pairs.definition: Schema failures should predict canonical validity failures.
pairs.failure_case: Schema-valid plan with overlapping room interiors.

pairs.definition: Token grammar violations should predict canonical RPLAN validity.
pairs.failure_case: Grammar-valid sequence with degenerate room geometry.

pairs.definition: Instruction-to-region grounding should predict executable edit success.
pairs.failure_case: Correct room grounding with unsupported edit operation.
